page.overview:
Who is Big Mildew?

Stripevincible (attempted killer) Slaying Mantis

Big Mildew is one of the minor characters, who became a superhero in Invincible.

Big Mildew is a large, hulk-like figure. He has green skin and brown markings on his hands, feet, face, chest and back.

Nothing much is known about Big Mildew's backstory. At some point, he got his powers and became a superhero (and he also works for the Global Defense Agency).
